message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Lint

on:
  pull_request: ~
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.pnpm-store
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/prepare
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm lint",
  "rationale": "The repository runs pnpm on every lint job and ships a pnpm-lock.yaml, with CI history showing repeated successful runs. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE applies because dependency fetching is repeated and cache inputs (lockfile plus runner OS) are available; no equivalent cache exists and the cached pnpm store is dependency download state, not mutable or untrusted build output. Adding an actions/cache step for the pnpm store before the prepare/install step preserves checkout, build, lint, and all required checks while reducing repeated dependency download time. No permissions are weakened and no privileged, deployment, publishing, or new external network actions are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

name: Lint
